title: tx_queue_stats_get non-atomic read on multi-word struct
description:
Header tx_queue.h line 207-208 claims 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation at lines 424-429 does NOT take the lock and explicitly comments 'This read is not atomic'. On architectures where struct tx_queue_stats (6x uint32_t = 24 bytes) is not atomically copyable, concurrent writes during stats collection could produce inconsistent diagnostic data.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 424
